t: This is Mornington Street, a street in the London Borough of Camden. It takes its name from Garret Wesley, the first Earl of Mornington, an Anglo-Irish politician and composer. He was the father of a distinguished military commander and several politicians. The street is also the birthplace of Samuel Shattock, who was born here in 1852 and became a British pathologist and a Fellow of the Royal Society. There's not much more on record about the street itself, but those two names connect it to Irish aristocracy on one side and Victorian medicine on the other.
